subject: general
question: The Government of India has mandated the nationwide sale of E20 petrol (20% ethanol-blended petrol) with a minimum Research Octane Number (RON) of 95, effective from which date?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 April 2026.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Government of India has mandated the nationwide sale of E20 petrol with a minimum RON 95 from April 1, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Starting 1 April 2026, all petrol retail outlets across India must sell only E20 petrol, which is a blend of 80% gasoline and 20% ethanol.**
 
• The mandate also specifies a **minimum Research Octane Number (RON) of 95**, which is higher than the current standard, ensuring better engine performance.
 
• This move is a primary milestone under the **Ethanol Blending Programme (EBP)**, aimed at transitioning away from the current E10 (10% ethanol) standard.
 
• The policy applies to all **Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs)** and private players in the oil marketing sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Research Octane Number (RON)__

 __
 
• A measure of a fuel's ability to resist "knocking" or "pinging" during combustion in an engine; a higher RON indicates higher fuel quality and efficiency.
 
 
 
• Ethanol Blending Programme (EBP)__
 __
 
• A government initiative to blend ethanol (derived from sugarcane, maize, etc.) with petrol to reduce crude oil imports and carbon emissions.
 
 
 
• Environmental Impact__
 __
 
• E20 fuel helps in reducing **carbon monoxide (CO)** and hydrocarbon emissions, contributing to India's climate goals and net-zero ambitions.
 
 
 
• Petroleum Planning & Analysis Cell (PPAC)__
 
 
• An attached office of the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas that assists in maintaining data and analyzing trends in the oil and gas sector.
